title: "Nightscout Follower" imported insulin types
body:
Using "Nightscout Follower" as data source provided by Juggluco with "Download Treatments" makes no difference between short and long acting insulin. The IoB behaves the same for short and long acting insulin.

Feature request: Selection of the insulin profile for the long/short acting insulin which is used during import.
